functions.description: Parse base Ivanti ICS 'ive' syslog structure into named fields

conf.regex: /^(?<timestamp>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}) (?<host>\S+) ive: id=(?<event_id>\S+) severity=(?<severity>\S+) vpn="(?<vpn>[^"]*)" sessionId=(?<session_id>"[^"]*"|\S+) user="(?<user>[^"]*)" realm="(?<realm>[^"]*)"(?: roles="(?<roles>[^"]*)")? src=(?<src_ip>\S+) dst=(?<dst_ip>\S+)(?: port=\d+)? msg="(?<message>[^"]*)"/

functions.description: Extract dst_port when present, regardless of its position on the line
Clean quoted session_id, coerce dst_port to number, flag IPv6 src addresses
Classify event category from event_id prefix and derive success/failure action from message content

add.name: protocol
add.value: event_id.match(/^AUT/) ? 'authentication' : event_id.match(/^NET/) ? 'network' : event_id.match(/^WEB/) ? 'web' : event_id.match(/^SSL/) ? 'tls' : event_id.match(/^SYS/) ? 'system' : event_id.match(/^ADM/) ? 'admin' : event_id.match(/^EAM/) ? 'endpoint' : 'unknown'
